meta_description: Download VpnHood! CONNECT, the free open-source VPN, for Android, iOS, Apple TV, Windows, or Linux — from Google Play, the App Store, or as a direct download.
hero_desc: Free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
note_free_availability: The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in China, Russia or other countries where ads are not served. Premium has no such limit.
windows_processor_note: Needs a processor with SSE4.2 and POPCNT, as every processor of the last ten years has.
direct_link_note: It's best to download with the direct link only when you don't have access to Google Play.
android_web_note: The version from the direct link does not use Google Play. It does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
android_arm64_desc: For most phones. The smaller download.
android_universal_desc: For old phones and many Android TVs.
windows_premium_note: The Windows version does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
ios_premium_note: The iOS and Apple TV versions do not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use them.
linux_distros_note: Supports Ubuntu 22.04 and later (including Kubuntu and Lubuntu), Debian 13 and Arch Linux; other distributions with systemd should also work.
linux_premium_note: The Linux version does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
